_about.use: Beyond Heroes bh-002 UI art manifest. Raster textures are authored at 2x: 'margins' are 9-slice patch margins in TEXTURE pixels (left, top, right, bottom; null = not a 9-slice) and 'scale' is the intended draw scale at 1920x1080 (0.5 = draw at half texel size, i.e. margins on screen = margins*scale; at 3840x2160 with the canvas_items stretch the same logical size maps 1:1 to texels). 'stretch' tells which axes may be stretched (both | h | v). 'content_margins' (texture px) is the padding for content inside the frame; 'expand_margins' (texture px) is transparent glow padding outside the visual edge. Centres of panel textures are periodic noise, so AXIS_STRETCH_MODE_TILE/TILE_FIT or STRETCH both work. Cursors are 1:1 with 'hotspot' in px. Regenerate everything with: python tools/ui_art/build_bh002.py
